user.title: RD30 Digital Interface
user.description: Connect to an RD30 behind a serial device server such as a Moxa NPort (TCP server mode, 9600 8N1, data packing off). The device is asked for its identity (command 1, reply 30) before the entry is created.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the serial device server.
data_description.port: TCP port of the serial device server (4001 on a Moxa NPort by default).

error.no_identify: The device did not answer the identity request (expected 30). Check the serial settings (9600 8N1), the crossed cable and data packing.

init.title: Configure inputs
init.description: Pick the input to name. Named inputs are enabled automatically; inputs without a name are created disabled and show up as “Input n”.

input.title: Input {number}
input.description: Name and device class of input {number}. Leave the name empty or tick “Reset” to remove the settings again.

data.name: Name
data.reset: Reset this input (remove name and device class)

data_description.name: Shown as the entity name, e.g. “Water leak utility room”.
data_description.device_class: Controls the icon and the on/off wording in Home Assistant.
